verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a federal portal that holds registrant and entity data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no setting, policy, or documentation letting users exclude their data from AI model training. The tiered CUI/FOUO access model and the published robots.txt crawl policy are adjacent access controls, not a user-facing training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
